sources.source: Kimball Group, "Additive, Semi-Additive, and Non-Additive Facts"

items.item: Additive measures can be summed across any dimension associated with the fact table
Semi-additive measures sum across some dimensions but not all; balance amounts are additive except across time
Some measures, such as ratios, are completely non-additive
The fix: store the fully additive components, sum those, then compute the final ratio, often in the BI layer

items.item: The atomic-grain reveal (step 5) and the coarse-grain-loses reveal (step 6) are both run against a real, disclosed throwaway order-line and order-header pair built for this topic, not a described hypothetical — the sum-to-order-total check and the missing-column observation are both executed, not asserted

The semi-additive demonstration (step 9) uses a real four-quarter balance series where summing gives a concrete, wrong number (four hundred sixty) against the concrete, correct year-end figure (one hundred fifty), rather than describing the mismatch abstractly

The non-additive demonstration (step 10) uses two real regions' revenue and cost figures, computing both the naive average and the correctly recomputed margin, with the two measured values genuinely differing rather than being chosen to differ only in principle

The grain predict (step 4) is red-teamed against the plausible wrong answer that the order itself, being the natural business unit, should be the grain; the reveal shows the atomic grain is the line, not the order, and that the order-level choice cannot answer line-level questions at all

items.item: The closing check (Prove it) applies the non-additive fix to a new measure (a per-unit shipping-cost ratio) rather than re-testing the exact profit-margin figures from the reveals
The recap keeps the four-step process, the grain-first binding rule, and the three additivity classes as three separate ideas rather than collapsing them into one vague "model carefully" takeaway

The bridge from topic 7 (Data Vault 2.0) is answered explicitly: this topic is framed as building a Kimball star for real, starting exactly where Kimball's own methodology insists (grain, before a single column is drawn), and the handoff to the next topic (fact table types) is confirmed by reading both CHAPTER.md entries side by side
